payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the source image into a drawing made from chalk.
outcome.target: The edited image should retain the recognizable scene while rendering it throughout as a chalk-made drawing, with a visibly chalky, dusty texture and drawn rather than photographic appearance.
outcome.reference: Compare the source and edited images, assessing whether the edited image depicts the same scene as a chalk drawing rather than a photograph or an unrelated/partial effect.

check.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the source image into a drawing made from chalk?
check.complete_when: The recognizable scene is rendered throughout as a chalk drawing, with a distinctly chalky, dusty, drawn texture and appearance rather than photographic rendering.
check.partial_when: A visible chalk-like drawing effect is present, but the scene remains partly photographic or the chalk transformation is otherwise incomplete.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the edited image remains photographic or has no visible chalk-drawing transformation.
check.unknown_when: The available image evidence is insufficient to determine whether the scene has been transformed into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The same two giraffes and outdoor scene remain recognizable, but the edited image is rendered throughout with soft, dusty, grainy strokes and drawn outlines rather than photographic detail, giving it a clear chalk-drawing appearance."}
